summary: An engineer who became an enterprise architect, then an executive leader. Two decades in, still building people, developing leaders, and pushing engineering execution to a higher standard. Decisions run on evidence over opinion and get written down. Teams own the whole system, including the parts that hurt. Organizations get designed so no one person is structurally required, and standards get repeated until they are known, because a standard nobody is aware of does not really exist. AI-assisted engineering is the latest arena for the same discipline: personal use before mandate, governance before scale, and leaders who stay in the work.

hero.tagline: Builds stronger leaders and stronger engineering systems.
